EVAL-F-03-S92.title: Implement Core Orchestration Logic for Clinical Trials and Provider Detail
EVAL-F-03-S92.description: Implement the facade orchestration methods that coordinate calls to clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service, including sequencing, data aggregation, and transformation into unified response structures.

EVAL-F-03-S93.title: Expose Facade Methods to Tool Router
EVAL-F-03-S93.description: Integrate EvaluateCare facade methods into the tool_router allowlist so that LLM tool calls can invoke clinical trials search and provider detail flows through the facade.

EVAL-F-03-S94.title: Write Unit Tests for EvaluateCare Facade
EVAL-F-03-S94.description: Create unit tests covering facade orchestration logic, including successful flows, error handling, and edge cases for both clinical trials and provider detail scenarios.

EVAL-F-03-S95.title: Integration Testing with Domain Services
EVAL-F-03-S95.description: Validate end-to-end integration between the facade and underlying domain services, ensuring correct data flow, response formatting, and compatibility with real API outputs (ClinicalTrials.gov and NPI Registry).
